title: JustSomeHighContrast
body:
# JustSomeHighContrast
### **It adds a high contrast (as in build-in minecraft resourse pack) for some mods**

_**This is part of the former [JustDarkModeAndTranslations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-some-translations-to-russian/)**_

<details>
<summary>Mods with high contrast</summary>

1. [Container Searcher](https://modrinth.com/mod/csearcher)
2. [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
3. [Grid](https://modrinth.com/mod/grid)
4. [Inventory Tabs](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-tabs)
5. [ItemSwapper](https://modrinth.com/plugin/itemswapper)
6. [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
7. [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica)
8. [Mob Health Bar (YDM's)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ydms-mobhealthbar)
9. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
10. [Notebook (Vanilla Notebook)](https://modrinth.com/mod/notebook)
11. [Screenshot Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/screenshot-viewer)
12. [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip)
13. [VTDownloader](https://modrinth.com/mod/vtdownloader)
14. [World Preview](https://modrinth.com/mod/world-preview)

</details>
